raw_text: Yemen's Houthi forces seize cargo ship in Red Sea, raising fears of wider conflict. Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi movement seized a cargo ship in the Red Sea on Sunday that it said was Israeli, in an escalation of its response to the Israel-Hamas war that has stoked fears of a widening Middle East conflict. Armed men landed on the deck of the Galaxy Leader vehicle carrier by helicopter south of the Suez Canal. The Bahamas-flagged, British-owned ship is operated by a company owned by Israeli businessman Rami Ungar, according to data from market intelligence firm Equasis. The ship was en route from Turkey to India carrying vehicles. The seizure was confirmed by the ship's operator and the Israeli military.
